newsitem.title: USA: Keycorp says to acquire Leasetec.
newsitem.headline: Keycorp says to acquire Leasetec.

text.p: KeyCorp said on Monday that it has agreed to acquire Leasetec Corp, a leading privately-held equipment leasing company headquartered in Boulder, Colo, for undisclosed terms.
The transaction is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997.
KeyCorp said it will account for the transaction as a purchase, and expects the acquisition to be accretive to 1997 earnings.
KeyCorp said neither the use of purchase accounting nor any resulting impact on KeyCorp's capital ratios would affect the company's ongoing common share repurchase program.
Tokyo Leasing Co Ltd will continue to hold a 20 percent stake in Leasetec, KeyCorp said.

The addition of Leasetec's $1.2 billion of leasing receivables and its new lease origination capabilities and international office network "will significantly increase the size and scope of KeyCorp's leasing organization, which ranks fourth among U.S. bank-based leasing companies," KeyCorp said.
KeyCorp Leasing Ltd had $2.7 billion of leasing receivables at December 31, 1996, and its new lease originations for 1996 exceeded $900 million, the company said.
